judgements.justification: B's GwuL said the promised PnP/RED comparisons 'should have been included in the main submission' and counted them too late, while A's nVFq accepted the same promise as 'satisfactory' and A accepted.
Both meta-reviews rest on the visible reviews and figures; the notes record no emergency reviewer or off-record assessment.
Both committees judged SNIPS as a method contribution and asked for the same baselines; neither applied a contribution-type standard the other did not.
The below-threshold scores (A's nVFq 5, B's GwuL 4) rest on missing baselines and novelty, which are central to the contribution.
